notes.title: The Optimization Launch Update
notes.notes:
[h3]We've introduced numerous optimizations to ensure the game runs smoothly across a wide range of computer configurations on launch day.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a soft lock that was preventing players from advancing past a specific enemy room.
[*] Addressed visual bugs caused by shader issues, resulting in a more visually appealing and immersive environment.
[*] Various minor bugs and issues have been resolved to enhance overall stability and gameplay fluidity.
[/list]
